title: Maine Barn Weddings | R&SVP – Hio Ridge, Bridgton
description: Sunday weddings for up to 135 guests in a restored 1820 barn in Bridgton, Maine. Ceremony in the field, reception in the barn. Alcohol-free. May through October.
heading: Weddings
lede: A wedding here is a Sunday on a farm that has been in one family for four generations. The ceremony is in the field facing Pleasant Mountain, the reception is in the barn, and the two of you get ready in the ell. We host up to 135 guests, May through October.
hero_alt: Ceremony benches in the field at Hio Ridge, birches and the tree line behind

steps.title: Get ready in the ell
steps.body: The bridal room and the groom's room are steps from the barn, each with a mirror and a place to sit.

steps.title: Ceremony in the field
steps.body: Benches made from the barn's old floorboards, facing Pleasant Mountain. On a wet day, the ceremony moves into the barn.

steps.title: Reception in the barn
steps.body: Dinner on the main floor and in the loft, dancing under the original beams, your caterer in the prep kitchen.

steps.title: Sunset on the patio
steps.body: String lights, the stone seating circle, and the view down the field as the light goes.

sunday.heading: Why Sundays
sunday.body: We keep Saturday as our day of rest, so our weddings are on Sundays. A Sunday wedding also means a quieter weekend for your guests, and most vendors have the date open. [CONFIRM: wording Susan is comfortable with]

faq.q: How many guests can the barn hold?
faq.a: 135. That is the capacity on our town permit for any event.

faq.q: Can we have our ceremony outside?
faq.a: Yes. The ceremony field faces Pleasant Mountain, with benches made from the barn's old floorboards. In rain, the ceremony moves into the barn.

faq.q: Can we bring our own caterer?
faq.a: Yes. There is a prep kitchen with barn doors your caterer can close while they finish the meal.

closing.heading: Plan your 2027 wedding here
closing.body: Tell us your date and about how many guests, and we will set up a private tour of the barn, the ell and the grounds.
